interpretationCommunicatedToOwner: Stop at 50 percent used in the reported weekly Codex allowance.
scope: Account-wide usage, not a per-task token budget or percentage of game completion.
procedure: Read fresh usage before substantial batches and periodically during ongoing work. At 50 percent used or above, save the current progress, pause the active goal under the owner's explicit instruction, report the measured usage, and stop goal work. Do not consume a reset or purchase credits. If usage becomes unavailable, do not start further substantial work until it can be checked.
note: This records a future stop condition. It does not change previously agreed design, preservation, GPT-review, GitHub-push or post-push cosmology gates.
